company.name: GroupAhead
company.shortDescription: GroupAhead enables real-life groups to create their own mobile apps to easily connect members.
company.description:
GroupAhead helps your members better connect and communicate by creating your group's own dedicated mobile app.

Push notifications from your app cut through the noise of email and Facebook, and the easy-to-access calendar helps increase attendance at your events, too.

With a simple, single-purpose app that focuses solely on connecting the organization, member involvement goes up - and makes organizers' lives dramatically easier.
